connector.name: FLOPS Compute Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: GPU compute price indices over MCP; every value carries a verify URL. Five key-free tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package flopsindex-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the zeroatflops account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FLOPS_API_KEY
env.description: Optional API key that upgrades the five public tools (list_indices, search_indices, get_price, get_index, verify) to full-precision values. Without it the tools work key-free and return the delayed public price. Forwarded as the X-FLOPS-Api-Key header. A partner tier with higher fidelity and expanded coverage is available — contact team@flopsindex.com.
